text:
Mira: Hey team — quick sync. We have 8 new preview customers enrolling tomorrow. Need to confirm staffing for kickoff calls, the feedback survey pipeline, and renewal-risk tagging in Gainsight.
Owen: I can cover two kickoff calls (11a PT, 2p PT).
Luis: Ill own the feedback survey and ingest. Planning to send a short NPS + feature checklist. Draft link: https://forms.redwood/sample-preview-survey. Can we add one question about latency sensitivity?
Mira: Yes add latency question and a short freeform for integration pain points. Keep it <= 5 mins.
Alex: FYI infra — well flip the telemetry flag to verbose for the first 48h of each tenant to capture cold-starts. Heads-up: this will add ~15% log volume.
Sasha: I can run the enablement session for the customers in EMEA (6pm CET). Will need the one-pager and example prompts + rate-limit guidance.
Mira: Owen/Sasha, split the one-pager: Owen = product flows, Sasha = ops/limits. Share by EOD.
Owen: On it. Ill drop a PR with the one-pager: https://git.redwood/preview/onboarding/paper.md (WIP).
Luis: For survey ingestion: tag responses with account_id and cohort_tag. Ill push them to the preview-feedback stream: kafka://redwood.preview.feedback.v1
Alex: deploy-bot: scheduled toggle for telemetry verbose (preview cohort) at 2026-05-12T15:00Z for 48h.
deploy-bot: Telemetry toggle scheduled by Alex for preview cohort: starts 2026-05-12T15:00Z, duration 48h.
Mira: Question on renewal-risk tagging — what criteria are we using to auto-flag? I want to surface to CSMs before demo week.
Luis: Proposal: auto-flag if NPS <= 5 OR reported latency issue OR integration blocker in freeform. Tag = "preview-risk-low".
Sasha: +1. Also flag accounts that skip the enablement session twice.
Owen: I'll add an internal check to add "enablement-missed" if no show.
Mira: Can we schedule a 15-min triage after day 3 of the cohort for any flagged accounts? Ill invite CSMs and ENG oncall.
Alex: Ill make sure the oncall rota is aware; add a runbook snippet: 
```
If flagged: check model variant routing, verify KV cache hit rates, collect example prompts, escalate to infra if p50 latency > 350ms
```
Luis: For feedback loops, Ill send a weekly CSV summary to cs-ops and product: account_id, nps, issues, flagged_reasons. Example: 
```
account_id,nps,issues,flagged
acme-123,8,"minor latency on long prompts",false
beta-77,4,"integration - auth errors",true
```
Sasha: Include timezone and preferred contact window in that export. Helps scheduling.
Mira: Last asks: (1) Owen/Sasha share one-pager by EOD; (2) Luis finalize survey + ingestion before midnight PT; (3) Alex confirm telemetry toggle scheduled and rota informed. Report back here when done.
Owen: One-pager draft pushed.
Luis: Survey final + ingestion wired. Pushed to kafka + tagged responses.
Alex: Telemetry toggle scheduled and rota pinged.
Sasha: One-pager ops section added. Calendar invite created for EMEA enablement: https://calendar.redwood/event/preview-emea-enable
Mira: Thanks everyone. Ill create the day-3 triage invite once enrollments confirmed.
Owen: Quick note — add batching recommendations snippet to the one-pager; a few customers asked.
Sasha: Added.
Mira: Post-week debrief Friday 10am PT. Flag issues in #customer-success or ping me. :pray:
Luis: Sending first-week summary to cs-ops & product on Friday EOD.
Alex: Dashboard cohort filter added; alerts for p90 > 500ms.
Mira: Thread resolved for now.
